route: Quercetin aglycone / exploratory BUB1B transcript response
decision: Do not elevate as a BUBR1-restoration lead. Retain a low-confidence, source-specific transcript screen; no MVA efficacy established.

primary_source.title: Quercetin accumulates in nuclear structures and triggers specific gene expression in epithelial cells

experiment.array_layout: One vehicle and one treated processed array at each timepoint in the deposited series matrix
experiment.normalization: RMA using raw data with GeneSpring GX v9.0, as stated in GEO sample metadata

analysis.summary: Small mixed-direction descriptive probe shifts; no replicate-level variance or inferential test is available.
not_measured: MVA1 cells or the nominated patient variants
